implementation.name: MC8051 (Oregano Systems)
implementation.notes: Oregano Systems published MC8051 on its own site and on OpenCores; neither is a git repository, so repo_url points at the copy actually used by the arcade FPGA ecosystem -- the one vendored into JTFRAME at modules/jtframe/hdl/cpu/8051 -- and the paths are relative to that repository.
